Title: Sensor status display
Text: The system shall display sensor status within 2 seconds of receiving a valid telemetry packet.

Title: Authentication failure logging
Text: The system shall log all failed authentication attempts within 2 seconds with timestamp, user identifier, and source IP address.

Title: Communication loss alert
Text: The system shall quickly alert the operator when communication is lost.

Title: Sensor status refresh duplicate
Text: The system shall display sensor status within 2 seconds after receiving a valid telemetry packet.

Title: Audit retention
Text: The system shall retain authentication audit records for at least 365 days after creation.

Title: Fault summary export
Text: The system shall export a fault summary file within 1 minute after the operator requests it.

Title: Malformed packet rejection
Text: The system shall reject malformed telemetry packets and display an error message within 1 second.

Title: Degraded mode banner
Text: The system shall display a degraded mode banner within 3 seconds when telemetry quality falls below 80 percent.

Title: Local configuration encryption
Text: The system shall encrypt local configuration files before writing them to disk.

Title: Retry count display
Text: The system shall display the connection retry count within 5 seconds after a retry attempt.

Title: Operator preference storage
Text: The system shall store operator display preference changes within 1 second when the user changes layout.

Title: Settings audit event
Text: The system shall create an audit entry within 2 seconds when an operator changes telemetry settings.

Title: Inactive session lock
Text: The system shall lock the local session after 15 minutes of operator inactivity.

Title: Telemetry packet processing
Text: The system shall process telemetry packets within 2 seconds.

Title: Duplicate packet discard
Text: The system shall discard duplicate telemetry packets received within 10 seconds of the original packet.

Title: Stale data label
Text: The system shall label sensor data as stale within 30 seconds after the last valid telemetry packet.

Title: Dropped packet retry
Text: The system shall retry dropped telemetry packets up to 3 times within 20 seconds.

Title: Authentication failure display
Text: The system shall display the source IP address on the authentication failure review screen.

Title: Review export generation
Text: The system shall generate a review export in HTML format within 60 seconds for projects under 100 requirements.

Title: Report appendix IDs
Text: The system shall include all imported requirement IDs in the report appendix when the report is generated.

Title: CSV quoted comma import
Text: The system shall import CSV fields from a source file containing quoted commas without splitting the field value.

Title: Blank requirement ID warning
Text: The system shall reject blank requirement identifiers and display an import warning within 2 seconds.

Title: Raw Jira field preservation
Text: The system shall preserve unmapped Jira CSV fields as raw attributes when importing each work item.

Title: JUnit skipped test import
Text: The system shall classify skipped JUnit test cases as skipped within the imported test evidence.

Title: Import warning display
Text: The system shall display import warnings within 2 seconds after an upload completes.

Title: Report audit event
Text: The system shall record a local audit event when a report is generated.

Title: Matrix sorting
Text: The system shall sort the traceability matrix by requirement identifier when the report is generated.

Title: Local SQLite export
Text: The system shall export the local project database within 30 seconds when the operator requests a backup.

Title: ReqIF parent hierarchy
Text: The system shall preserve parent requirement hierarchy from ReqIF imports when parent references are present.

Title: Weak wording phrase display
Text: The system shall display the weak wording phrase that triggered each weak requirement finding.

Title: Duplicate requirement candidate detection
Text: The system shall identify duplicate requirement candidates when normalized text similarity is above the configured threshold.

Title: Errored test import
Text: The system shall record JUnit error elements as errored test evidence when importing CI test results.

Title: Requirement ID normalization
Text: The system shall normalize requirement identifiers with underscores when parsing test names and issue text.

Title: Offline report assets
Text: The system shall generate HTML report files without external scripts, fonts, images, or style resources when the report is created.

Title: Local ruleset persistence
Text: The system shall save ruleset changes to local project storage within 2 seconds.

Title: Closed work verification list
Text: The system shall list closed work items that lack passing verification evidence when report analysis runs.

Title: Stale link review
Text: The system shall flag possible stale trace links when a changed requirement is linked to closed work.

Title: Report source filenames
Text: The system shall include imported source filenames in the report cover section when the report file is generated.

Title: CLI local execution
Text: The CLI shall run an analysis within 30 seconds without requiring account credentials or network access.

Title: ReqIFZ archive import
Text: The system shall import ReqIFZ archives under 10 MB without crashing.

Title: Project cleanup marker
Text: The system shall mark a local project inactive within 5 seconds when the operator removes it from the project list.

Title: Baseline change summary
Text: The system shall include added, deleted, and changed requirement counts when the baseline diff report is generated.
